task_description: Implement per-form sharing + email invites for Qivo: a new FormShare Prisma model (RESPONDER/EDITOR/VIEWER roles, PENDING/ACCEPTED status), a formShares API module (routes/service/schemas/access helpers) plus an invites surface, OR-fallback effective-access integration in form.service.ts that never weakens workspace checks, two Resend email templates (silent no-op without a key), a FORM_SHARED notification type, and the frontend share card + AcceptInvitePage + signup/login invite-token carry. Follows the approved design at .agents/tasks/form-share-feature/design.md.
